title: Spicy Keto Omelette
description: A quick and easy keto omelette packed with spicy flavor. Perfect for a low-carb breakfast or snack.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and add the spicy.
Once the pan is hot, add the eggs and cook until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the omelette towards the center.
Continue cooking and folding until the eggs are almost set.
Use the spatula to carefully fold the omelette in half and cook for another 30 seconds.
Slide the omelette out of the pan onto a plate and serve hot.
